maya (marketing): quick ask — we need a tight, reproducible smoke for launch materials: cold-start vs steady-state for text generation + embedding->rerank flow. want numbers and artifacts we can show in a slide (p50/p95/p99, mem, tail traces).

sam (eng-runtime): got it. can you list the exact models/variants and the quantized options you want? also which workload (tokens per request, batch sizes)?

maya (marketing): main story is latency/cost tradeoff. please include: redwood-v2-7b (fp16), redwood-v2-7b-q4_0, and a cheaper 3b variant. request profile: 64 token gen, and an embedding+rerank roundtrip (embed 384 tokens -> search -> rerank top10 with generate 32 tokens).

lena (runtime-bench): for reproducibility we'll need the payload generator seed/hash, warmup policy, and exact client concurrency. aim to include a single-run command and an artifacts bundle (raw traces, perf counters, mem profile, request/response samples).

andre (product): also capture the prompt templates used for the slide examples — marketing will want 3 short examples (chatty, terse, instruction).

sam (eng-runtime): plan: run 3 variants x 2 workloads x 2 warmup regimes (no-warmup vs 200 warmup iters). will limit concurrency so p95 isn't dominated by queueing: local load generator with concurrency=12 for gen, concurrency=24 for embed+rerank. I'll attach run commands.

sam (eng-runtime): ```
# smoke run (gen)
./bench/run.sh --model redwood-v2-7b --variant fp16 --seq 64 --batch 8 --concurrency 12 --warmup 200 --seed 1729 --out ./artifacts/run-gen-7b-fp16.tar

# embed+rerank
./bench/run_rerank.sh --embed-model redwood-embed-3b --rerank-model redwood-v2-3b --embed-seq 384 --rerank-gen 32 --batch 16 --concurrency 24 --warmup 200 --seed 1729 --out ./artifacts/run-rerank.tar
```

lena (runtime-bench): for quantized variant use the bench flag `--quantize q4_0` and include full kernel selection logs. we'll collect `perf_top` snapshots and the runtime trace (jaeger/span ids) for the demo.

maya (marketing): perfect. can you also include a quick table with cost-per-1k-requests estimate and an explanation line about why cold-start differs from steady-state? need it by EOD Thurs for webinar deck.

sam (eng-runtime): EOD Thurs is tight but feasible if we scope artifacts: (1) tar with traces + logs, (2) p50/p95/p99 CSV, (3) mem & GPU utilization curves png, (4) 3 sample request/response pairs. we can do that.

lena (runtime-bench): one more ask: include the `kv cache` hit rate and whether warmup used prefix caching. add a small note in the bundle about any manual priming prompts used.

maya (marketing): noted — will bake language for the slide. also please stamp the run with a deterministic git SHA and the `bench` docker image tag so we can reproduce.

sam (eng-runtime): will include `git_sha` and `image_tag` in artifacts metadata. scheduling: I'll spin jobs this afternoon, expect raw artifacts by 6pm PT, processed CSVs + PNGs by tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: Job 4123456790 started: bench-run-gen-7b-fp16 (user: sam).

maya (marketing): thank you! if the quantized p95 looks bad we'll probably fall back to showing median + a note. can the team also sanity-check that the sample outputs don't hallucinate any policy-sensitive text?

lena (runtime-bench): we'll include a small filter pass and mark any flagged outputs. if anything questionable shows up we'll redact and note it.

sam (eng-runtime): attaching initial ETA update: run-gen done (artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/launch/4123456790/run-gen-7b-fp16.tar). starting q4 runs now.

maya (marketing): awesome — ping when q4 artifacts are uploaded and when you have the p95 table. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Job 4123456793 completed: bench-run-gen-7b-fp16 (status: success, artifacts uploaded).
